description_en: Obtains the result returned by phone number analysis
description_zh: 获取号码分析返回结果
name: DescribePhoneNumberAnalysis

parameters.help_en:
The authorization code.

Log on to the Phone Number Service console (https://dytns.console.aliyun.com/analysis/apply), go to the My Applications page, and obtain the authorization ID, which is the authorization code
parameters.help_zh:
授权码。

在号码百科控制台 (https://dytns.console.aliyun.com/analysis/apply)我的申请页面，获取授权ID即授权码
parameters.name: auth_code

parameters.help_en: The phone number to be queried
parameters.name: input_number

parameters.help_en:
The type of the phone number. Valid values:

0: mobile phone number

1: mobile IMEI number
parameters.help_zh:
号码类型。取值：

0：手机号

1：手机IMEI号
parameters.name: number_type

parameters.help_en:
The encryption method of the phone number. Valid values:

NORMAL: no encryption

MD5

SHA256
parameters.help_zh:
号码的加密方式。取值：

NORMAL：不加密

MD5

SHA256
parameters.name: mask

parameters.help_en:
The score threshold of the phone number. Valid values: 0 to 100.

<notice>Whether the specified score threshold is accepted is determined by the server. When the specified score threshold is not accepted, the data entered in this field is invalid.></notice>
parameters.help_zh:
号码分数阈值。取值范围：0~100。

<notice>是否接受指定的分数阈值由服务端决定。当不接受指定分数阈值时，此字段输入的数据无效。></notice>
parameters.name: rate

AccessDeniedDetail.description_en: The details about the access denial. This parameter is returned only if RAM verification fails
AccessDeniedDetail.description_zh: 访问被拒绝详细信息；只有RAM校验失败才会返回此字段

Code.description_en:
The request status code. Valid values:

 OK: The request was successful
Code.description_zh:
请求状态码。取值：

 OK：成功

Data.description_en: The information about the phone number analysis result
Data.description_zh: 号码分析返回结果信息

Code.description_en:
The result code returned.
YES: valid
NO: invalid
UNKNOWN: unknown
Code.description_zh:
返回的结果编码。
YES：有效
NO：无效
UNKNOWN：未知

Number.description_en: The mobile phone number that is passed in

Message.description_en: The description of the phone number status
